in_hindi.name: प्रशांत
in_hindi.long_meaning: Prashant is a name of Sanskrit origin, which has its roots in the Sanskrit word 'shanti'. Shanti means peace, calmness, and tranquility. In Hindi, the name Prashant is written as प्रशांत and is pronounced as prashAnt.

in_tamil.name: பிரசந்த
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name Prashanth is derived from the Sanskrit word 'prashant', which means calm, peaceful and serene.
